name: Multiverse Computing
description: Multiverse Computing provides quantum AI software for enterprise applications, specializing in optimization and machine learning. Their flagship product Singularity enables model compression and quantum-inspired algorithms for finance, energy, and manufacturing sectors.

products.name: Singularity
products.description: Quantum AI platform for model compression, optimization, and quantum-inspired machine learning at enterprise scale

highlights: Flagship Singularity platform serves finance, energy, and manufacturing sectors with quantum AI
EUR 25M+ raised, one of Europe's best-funded quantum software startups
Specializes in model compression and quantum-inspired algorithms for near-term enterprise value

news.title: HyperNova 60B, the world's most efficient model in its category according to Artificial Analysis
news.excerpt: Multiverse Computing's model has been independently validated and ranks as the one that best combines high intelligence with a compact parameter footprint among models of its size.

news.title: Pushing the Classical Frontier of Quantum Simulation
news.excerpt: Scientists at Multiverse Computing have achieved a major milestone in large-scale quantum many-body simulation, demonstrating that advanced tensor-network methods can reach regimes previously thought to be beyond classical computational capabilities.

news.title: Multiverse Computing releases free compressed HyperNova 60B AI model
news.excerpt: Spanish 'soonicorn' ships CompactifAI-compressed HyperNova 60B on Hugging Face amid reports of a €500M round at a €1.5B valuation.

news.title: Multiverse Computing and Axelera AI partner to bring compressed AI models to edge devices
news.excerpt: Collaboration uses CompactifAI compression with Axelera's edge AI accelerators to run datacentre-class models on energy-efficient devices.
